_comment: Per-platform low/medium/high model tiers for spinning up a SUBAGENT at a given effort (never applies to a human's own top-level model choice). Consumed by scripts/guardlib/model_family.py as a soft nudge, and meant to be read by the orchestrating agent BEFORE calling Agent/Task so it can pick the right model up front. Cursor 2026-09-01: Task spawn has model only, no effort field; live subagentStart payloads never carry effort; Composer 2.5 has no effort concept. The -high suffix is part of the model slug. Cursor effort keys are unused (effort_settable: false). Claude and Antigravity effort fields remain unverified on those platforms.
